problem: The report-preview page could not obtain a challenge_final report: onLoad routed challenge_final into _loadReportFromFallback, which only read leftover globals/storage and never requested generation, so the page showed '暂无报告 先完成一次认知挑战' and the 9.9入口 was unreachable (chicken-and-egg: must already have a report to generate one). There was also no purchase path that carried the SERVER reportId: the report-lock '解锁' went to /pages/membership/membership with no product/record args (defaulted to challenge_39_9), and membership.js hard-fell back to a local 39.9 product and passed relatedId=recordId||'challenge_unlock'. The finalizer grants full_report + sets ai_reports.isPaid only for reportId===relatedId, so report_9_9 orders created without the reportId could never unlock the report.

changes.CONTRACT_VERIFIED: generateAiReport(type='challenge_final', recordId=<挑战记录ID>) → { reportId(=ARCF…), status?, locked, summary?|content? }; getAiReport(reportId); createOrder(productId, relatedId). reportId is a distinct server id, NOT the challenge recordId. report-lock vs report-detail confirmed to be different UIs (inline lock card vs separate page).
changes.REPORT_PREVIEW_STATE_MACHINE: challenge_final onLoad now calls _startChallengeFinal() → generateAiReport('challenge_final', recordId). States: loading→(generating|ready|failed|error). generating shows '生成中' and re-checks with a BOUNDED, spaced poll (6×5s=30s cap) that is stopped on onUnload and on any terminal state. failed shows an explicit message + controlled retry (onRetryReport) that re-requests the SAME logical report. ready sets locked strictly from the server payload (fail-closed: only explicit locked:false unlocks) and shows summary (locked) or the full-report CTA (unlocked). Missing recordId → error state.
changes.NINE_NINE_ENTRY: onGenerate() requires cfState==='ready' and a server-issued reportId, then navigates to /pages/membership/membership?source=report&productId=report_9_9&recordId=<reportId>. It never computes a report id client-side and never passes the challenge recordId as relatedId.
changes.MEMBERSHIP_ADAPT: membership.js: for report_9_9 the relatedId passed to createOrder is the SERVER reportId; a missing reportId sets blockedNoRecord and hard-blocks order creation (no createOrder call). Price always comes from the server getProductList config (no fabricated fallback) — report_9_9 fails closed if absent; challenge_39_9 keeps its legacy local fallback unchanged. onShow-return re-reads authoritative report state (no local isPaid=true). Cancel/pending/failure all show correct non-unlocked messaging.
changes.WXML: report-preview.wxml challenge_final block rewritten to switch on cfState (loading/generating/failed/error/ready); membership.wxml gains a blockedNoRecord branch and drops the '39.90' default in the pay-button label.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/report-preview-wiring.test.js (M1–M6 membership, P1–P8 preview; 45 assertions) using vm-loaded REAL page sources with stubbed services: contract of ids, 9.9 entry params, no default-39.9 fallback, missing-reportId block, ready/generating(bounded)/failed+retry/unload-stop/error flows, and fail-closed onGenerate. Registered in tests/rc8.9/run.js.

deployNote: Client-only batch (miniprogram). No cloud function deploy. Uploaded as a WeChat preview build.
